@cfworker/json-schema 4.1.1
https://github.com/cfworker/cfworker/tree/main/packages/json-schema

The files in this folder are the package's dist/esm build, unchanged, as
published to npm (registry.npmjs.org/@cfworker/json-schema/-/json-schema-4.1.1.tgz).
PUDL's action broker (dist/pudl-actions.js) loads index.js as an ES module.
It checks schemas without compiling them to code, so it works under a
content security policy that forbids eval.

The package's package.json gives its licence as MIT and its author as
Jeremy Danyow; the package itself carries no licence file, so the MIT
licence's text is given here.
